title: Effect of Filter Lifespan in CRRT on New Infections in Critically Ill Patients With AKI
official: The Effect of Filter Lifespan in Continuous Renal Replacement Therapy on the Rate of New Infections in Critically Ill Patients With AKI: a Prospective Observational Study
summary: This observational study aims to explore the factors that influence the risk of new infections in critically ill patients with acute kidney injury (AKI) requiring continuous renal replacement therapy (CRRT) in the UK.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* age ≥ 18 years
* critically ill patients with AKI in whom CRRT is planned

Exclusion Criteria:

* chronic kidney disease with eGFR\<30ml/min/1.73m2
* Chronic dialysis dependency
* kidney transplant
* known (Glomerulo-) nephritis, interstitial nephritis, vasculitis
* known to be on immunosuppression, including Methotrexate, Cyclosporine, Antibody immunosuppression (e.g., rituximab, infliximab), Glucocorticoid as long-term medication at a dose above the cushing threshold
* known chronic inflammatory diseases (e.g. arthritis, HIV with a CD4 count of \< 0.05 x 10E/l, chronic hepatitis)
* participation in an interventional trial within the last 3 months investigating a drug that affects kidney function
sponsor: Guy's and St Thomas' NHS Foundation Trust
